name: ecp-codex
description: Check, enable, disable, and govern ECP projects through four focused Skills backed by one bundled local Core.

interface.shortDescription: Long-lived project truth and change control
interface.longDescription: Projects default to ECP off. One Plugin exposes four focused Skills for read-only checks, explicit project enablement, explicit project disablement, and governed repository changes. All four share one checksum-verified local Core for supported Darwin/Linux arm64/amd64 hosts, so users do not install or operate a separate CLI. Enabled projects recover accepted Project Truth, close material requirement ambiguity, create bounded Changes with structured Impact, select minimal required Gates, reconcile durable semantics, and close only current evidence-backed PASS lifecycles without exposing protocol tokens.
capabilities: Focused project check, enable, disable, and change Skills
Accepted Project Truth and structured Change Impact
Cancelled Change baseline and lineage preservation
Path-derived impact and minimal sufficient Gate selection
Durable GateRun history and interruption recovery
Read-only authority integrity and capacity diagnostics
defaultPrompt: Check whether ECP is enabled here and report the bundled Core identity.
Enable ECP here with honest Project Truth and safe local Gates.
Disable ECP here while preserving source, Evidence, and history.
